results.rationale: Consistency: hedge layout and central statue persist, but stone-path textures are noticeably redrawn. Instruction: a short horizontal red stroke crosses the upper-middle maze rather than connecting top-left to bottom-right through corridors. Knowledge: it passes through multiple hedge walls and never reaches the exit; instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: coherent overhead garden map with clear walls, paths and red annotation.

Consistency: labels and most country borders remain, but black exterior changes to pale grey/green and southern Italy is swallowed by green fill. Instruction: requested colors appear, but country regions are not consistently filled and adjacent countries repeatedly share colors. Knowledge: Poland/Czech Republic/Slovakia share red and Austria/Hungary/Italy share blue; instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: legible map labels and edges overall, with a faint ghosted southern-Italy outline.
